survey: A stage spotlight (PAR-style can) hanging from a short truss section. Truss: two parallel horizontal tubes joined by end posts and diagonal braces, seen at a three-quarter angle from below. Mount: a center clamp wraps both truss tubes and is held by a bolt. A short vertical stem runs down from the clamp to the top center of a U-shaped yoke, which gives the pan axis. Yoke: its right arm ends in a round tilt knob on the side of the can. Its left arm runs down behind the can, where the matching pivot would be out of view. Can: a cylindrical housing with vent slots on top and a thick front rim. Three round lenses (yellow, cyan, red) sit inside the rim and face down-left toward the camera. Colored light beams spread from the lenses toward the lower left. No power cable is shown, and a card can leave that out.
